# Maxim — Personal Tech Blog

Maxim is a specialized tech blog focusing on quantitative finance, quantum systems, and artificial intelligence.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Vite + React
- Styling: Custom Vanilla CSS with Design Tokens
- Icons/Assets: Unsplash Editorial CDNs

## Core Content Areas
- Algorithmic Trading (MQL5)
- Quantum Computing & Physics Paradoxes
- Cybersecurity Strategy
- AGI & AI Alignment

## Editorial Philosophy
Broadsheet newspaper aesthetic, smooth intersection-observer based transitions, and high-contrast walnut-on-parchment typography.
